bullets.id: Emas sempat menembus $4.200 di sesi Asia Senin, lalu berbalik dan ditutup turun 0,59% ke $4.168,90. Pada Selasa, emas melemah ke arah $4.150, penurunan hari kedua berturut-turut, karena dolar AS naik ke level tertinggi 18 bulan menjelang data inflasi CPI AS hari Rabu.
bullets.en: Gold briefly broke above $4,200 in Monday’s Asian session, then reversed and closed down 0.59% at $4,168.90. On Tuesday it slipped toward $4,150, its second straight daily decline, as the US dollar rose to an 18-month high ahead of Wednesday’s US CPI inflation data.

bullets.id: Minyak kembali naik pada Senin: Brent $106,65 (+1,8%) dan WTI $93,74 (+2,1%), menambah kekhawatiran inflasi. Yield 10 tahun bertahan di 5,24%. Pasar memberi peluang sekitar 17% kenaikan suku bunga Oktober dan sekitar 88% setidaknya satu kenaikan hingga Desember. Emas turun sekitar 3% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: Oil rose again on Monday: Brent at $106.65 (+1.8%) and WTI at $93.74 (+2.1%), adding to inflation worries. The 10-year yield held at 5.24%. Markets price about a 17% chance of an October rate hike and about 88% for at least one hike by December. Gold is down about 3% on the month and about 26% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Kitco menandai support di $4.155 lalu $4.141,86, dengan $4.103 di bawahnya. Resistance di $4.220,89 dan $4.226,82, lalu $4.271,57. Setelah CPI hari Rabu, pasar menunggu data PPI dan penjualan ritel AS pada Kamis.
bullets.en: Kitco marks support at $4,155, then $4,141.86, with $4,103 below that. Resistance sits at $4,220.89 and $4,226.82, then $4,271.57. After Wednesday’s CPI, markets await US PPI and retail sales data on Thursday.

bullets.id: Antam turun Rp20.000 ke Rp2.574.000/gram dan buyback turun Rp25.000 ke Rp2.383.000, spread Rp191.000 (sekitar 7,4%). Galeri24 Rp2.537.000 (buyback Rp2.396.000) dan UBS Rp2.562.000 (buyback Rp2.370.000). Di sisi struktural, ETF emas global mencatat arus masuk rekor $31 miliar pada kuartal III dan kepemilikan rekor 4.256 ton.
bullets.en: Antam fell Rp20,000 to Rp2,574,000/gram and buyback fell Rp25,000 to Rp2,383,000, a Rp191,000 spread (about 7.4%). Galeri24 is at Rp2,537,000 (buyback Rp2,396,000) and UBS at Rp2,562,000 (buyback Rp2,370,000). Structurally, global gold ETFs posted record Q3 inflows of $31 billion and record holdings of 4,256 tonnes.
